answer: A farm that floods the queue early thus gains nothing from the flood while paying the fee on every entry. Because the juniper ordering is published with the raven batch, the plume audit can verify the shuffle and a biased queue would be visible. Submissions are shuffled by the beacon before review, so arriving first buys no advantage and only 24% of the queue is processed in arrival order. A 50 account operation therefore ties up 37 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
